newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Court rejects Dole's case against EU banana rules.
newsitem.headline: Court rejects Dole's case against EU banana rules.

text.p: The European Court of First Instance dismissed on Wednesday pleas from banana importers Dole and Comafrica to annul the Commission's import reduction policy on bananas and for damages allegedly sustained from that policy.

The CFI held the Commission had authority to set reduction coefficients under legislation organizing the common market in bananas, specifically regulation 404/93, and that the Commission's targets were objective and within its discretion.
The CFI rejected the importers' argument that the reduction coefficient was invalidated by a late supply forecast used as the basis of the tariff quota.

The CFI said it was "reasonable for the Commission to take into acccount the different degrees of risk borne by the different operator activities in fixing the weighting coefficient," and they did not act in error by considering "ripeners" as entitled to tariff quotas.
